title: CitationCreated
description: An address was fetched and kept as an asset. The address stays in the event because the copy and the page drift apart from that moment. Keys are snake_case, not the camelCase the rest of leaf uses: this travels inside a Liquid envelope, whose own fields (event_id, occurred_at, event_type, owner_unit_ref) are snake_case and pinned byte-exact by signed golden vectors. The shape follows the wire.

content_id.description: The asset the fetched page became.

source_url.description: The address it was fetched from.

session_id.description: The working session it was fetched into.
